owner: Original Koppeling Studio / ONE BRAIN / Heartbeat
root_cause: After introducing provider-neutral source/target and transfer policy, the saved-connector list had no edit action for existing direction/frequency and only configuration/trust cards; operator could misinterpret Active or hourly cadence as proven recurring provider sync.
prevention_rule: Persisted custom source/target transfer policy must be reloadable and revalidated on every PUT; changed config invalidates the original version-bound proof. Monitoring must independently match tenant, connector version, provider, snapshot columns/row count/hash and real source receipt before claiming records. Desired cadence never implies an executing scheduler, next run or operational SLA.

implementation.owner: Original tenant-aware Netlify handler and Supabase source store
implementation.sourceReadback: SOURCE_SYNCED + matching provider SHA + same tenant/source/fields/version
implementation.editFlow: Saved custom design to original PUT /draft, version bump and old proof invalidation
